notes.title: Bug Fixes- First Patch incoming
notes.content:
We have a hotfix patch coming in to fix a couple small bugs on this build. The biggest being the online Leader board not taking new submissions. While most the time bugs are harder to solve, this one was pretty simple.


We left the line that submits commented out from our testing. But, never fear it's fixed and we'll be pushing that change to you, our adoring fans shortly.

If you find any other bugs, please make a post so we can see what we can do about it.


Thanks for being on time,

Dell Barnes 
Art Lead
FunkFizz
